_doc: TEMPLATE niche config. Do not edit in place: `py -3 -m control.niche clone _template <id> "<Name>"` then fill niches/<id>/niche.json. Keys starting with _doc are comments. Run `py -3 -m control.niche check <id>` until it exits 0.

identity._doc: Who the brand is. product_noun is singular ('handbag'), product_noun_plural ('handbags'). handle = social @ (same on IG/TikTok). lang_ui = Control Center UI language. timezone = IANA name used for scheduling.

site._doc: public_url = link-in-bio target / canonical domain. assets_base_url = host that serves hosted images (GitHub Pages host or the custom domain). img_dir = repo folder for product images. pages_repo = owner/repo of the GitHub Pages site. pages_dir = folder (relative to this repo) holding the compliance pages; '.' = repo root.

sourcing._doc: aliexpress_searches = [[search term, clean English category label], ...]. shops = brand/shop domains for the scout. Need at least one of the two.

thresholds._doc: Scout quality gates: min orders sold, min rating, min price (USD), batch size per scout run, brand min price, days before a product may repeat, min value score.

schedule._doc: slots = daily post times for a 3-post drop (local time). skip_weekdays: 0=Mon..6=Sun. post_slot = slot for single image posts. tiktok_slot_local / tiktok_max_per_day = TikTok re-spread rules. timezone = IANA name.

research._doc: trend_queries = web/TikTok searches for the trend scout.

publishing._doc: provider = scheduler API (zernio). hashtags = 5-8 niche+reach tags. cta = call to action (never a URL in captions). disclosure_tags = mandatory affiliate disclosure. env = NAMES of env vars in scripts/.env (values never go here).

production._doc: space_id = the Magnific Space duplicated for this niche; nodes = node ids inside it (input_image = campaign image generator, source_creation = source product creation node, ads_list, video_insta, video_tiktok). space_label = Space title shown to the owner in Telegram. burn_overlay = burn price/deal into posts (false = clean photos). agents_dir = folder with persona/poses/stylist/qa .md.

pinterest._doc: board = target board name. title_openers = list of editorial pin-title openers (distinct leading words; Pinterest dedups on them). hashtags / keywords = strings used in pin description / Keywords column.

compliance._doc: Affiliate-program safety rules. Keep them: IG restricted links once. required_pages must exist in site.pages_dir.
compliance.secrets: only in scripts/.env (gitignored); never in code or git remote URL
